prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE exquisite integrated Fool pathway + rank 8 insignia, continuing a coherent family of ornate mask-and-curtain numerals. Reference 1 supplies the Fool theatrical half-mask and smoky-purple curtain identity; reference 2 supplies the exact readable Arabic numeral 8. Agentic sculptural redesign: fuse their structure and negative spaces into ONE complete object, never a numeral pasted over a separate crest. Two closed curtain loops with a narrow shared waist form 8, a smaller upper counter and a larger lower counter; carve mask profiles into the right sides of the continuous strokes, without blocking either hole. No extra outline around the 8. The ONLY readable digit is 8, unmistakable small. Antique pale gold, mist silver, ivory carved mask, smoky violet enamel drapery; museum jewelry-level microchasing, sculptural relief, satin recesses and polished bevels. Rich but coherent detail, no surrounding badge, no words, no other digit. FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC square image; full object centered with generous 8% clear margins, no cropped tips. Genuinely transparent background including internal openings; no white backdrop or checkerboard pixels, no external cast shadow. Preserve the mask's identity and the numeral's readability together.
